title: TrainRenderHarnessResult
description: JSON shape produced by .atdd/harness/mount-train.mjs on stdout. The Python validator parses each result, classifies it via TrainRenderAnalyzer, and emits Violation records for empty/stub/error cases.

trainId.description: The train identifier the harness mounted.

textLength.description: Length of textContent.trim() in the mounted DOM container.

matchedExpectations.description: Subset of expected_content.must_contain entries that were found in the rendered DOM.

stubDetected.description: True when the rendered DOM matches the loader/skeleton/placeholder heuristic (see TrainRenderAnalyzer).

stubReason.description: When stubDetected is true, a one-line explanation (e.g. 'aria-busy=true on root container').

error.description: When non-null, the harness failed to mount this train. The validator emits TESTER-RENDER-003.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the mount in milliseconds.
